bounded_question: Can the accepted situation-first Production Shaping / Current Possibility hierarchy become a real workspace inside the COMP-02 shell while preserving current-thread dominance, contextual inspection, focus/selection separation and Product-open boundaries?
frozen_inputs: COMP-02 durable shell and Production scope behavior
construction_law: Home / Productions / Settings remain the thin durable shell; Shaping does not become a new permanent taxonomy tab.
Current Production and current situation remain the dominant semantic frame.
People, relationship, pressure, question and world-context labels are orientation/follow targets, not database silos.
Selected meaning opens contextual inspection; keyboard focus may move independently without creating selection.
Current possibility names the creator working frame and must not imply predictive/generated next-action authority.
Deep inspection is deliberate follow-through and preserves exact semantic origin/return.
Current/historical and provisional/effective meaning remain structural and hue-independent.
No Stage redesign or Product-gated control is introduced.
mechanical_acceptance: zero undersized icon-only controls below 32px reference carrier
exactly one selected meaningful element per theme
keyboard focus can target a different meaningful element without moving selection
meaningful-element activation updates contextual inspection without changing durable navigation
no external resources or image dependency
visual_falsification: current situation must dominate orientation, inspector and durable shell chrome
the workspace must not read as a People/World/Scenes ontology browser
the meaning list must read as one authored field rather than a card/dashboard grid
contextual inspection must remain visibly subordinate to the current situation
Light/Dark must preserve identical navigation, disclosure and inspection meaning
narrow layout must preserve one primary reading sequence and exact return context
explicit_non_goals: prediction/recommendation of what should happen next
result_law: Responsive or interaction-plumbing repairs may change geometry/DOM mechanics only. Any change to accepted Shaping semantics or frozen F2/D3/MAT/TYP/STA/FICON/Stage mechanisms requires a separately named successor rather than silent COMP-03 retuning.
